classification.2: Official URDF value, not independently validated
classification.4: Assumed or conditional because physical information is unavailable

scout.chassis_mass_method: kerb mass minus four official-URDF wheel masses; conditional, class 4
scout.suspension: locked at nominal URDF stance; no unmeasured spring/damper parameters
scout.wheel_inertia_method: uniform solid cylinder centered on the measured tire envelope; mass is official/unvalidated
scout.placement_method: manufacturer manual wheelbase and tire-center track; retain source URDF vertical stance; do not scale meshes

arm.torque_profile: standard Piper / pyAgxArm PiperFW.DEFAULT command envelope, not continuous motor rating
arm.gear_interpretation: joint-side torque commands, not a physical gearbox ratio

simulation.joint_losses: zero on arm, fingers, wheels and free base; no identified friction/damping available

scout_mini.source: Scout Mini manual performance table, PDF page 8; kerb mass includes wheels and battery

piper.source: Piper manual V1.0 2025.06, PDF pages 9-10; gripper is listed separately

unknown_parameters.scout: individual measured wheel mass; battery and drivetrain mass split; COM and inertia; suspension spring/damper curves; tire stiffness and friction; reflected rotor inertia; brake/backdrive behavior
unknown_parameters.piper: internal material/density distribution and independently validated COM/inertia for most links; physical gear reductions; rotor inertia; identified friction/damping; continuous torque/speed ratings; installed firmware revision
